note_en: 只要……就…… means "as long as / all you have to do is … and …": 只要刷一下身份证就能直接进站 "all you have to do is scan your ID card and you can go straight in." English usually needs only one connecting word, but Chinese marks both halves: 只要 introduces the condition and 就 (placed right before the verb of the result) introduces what follows. Leaving out 就 sounds unfinished to Chinese ears.
